statements.statement: The patient presents with intermittent episodes of palpitations
The patient presents with episodes of dizziness and giddiness
These symptoms have persisted despite initial evaluation
A mobile cardiac telemetry study (CPT 93229) is ordered
The service is for continuous ambulatory monitoring
The diagnosis codes are R00.2 and R42
The claim was denied based on Reason Code CO-197
The denial is based on lack of required precertification or prior authorization
The authorization was absent before services were rendered
